reason: Both reviews explicitly define the same full MSSM field content; interaction/R-parity choices do not alter gauge-matter identity.
inspected_scope: P21 Tables1.1/1.2 PDFpp9-10 and P22 AppendixA PDFpp227-228; one 4D MSSM gauge-basis spectrum.

claims.value: Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

Source explicitly tabulates three-family MSSM chiral supermultiplets; scalars complex and fermions LH Weyl. Hu,Hd Y=+/-1/2; gauge supermultiplets are adjoint gluino/wino/bino. Expand into independent scalar/Weyl rows, no auxiliary F and no double conjugation.

Minimal visible messenger example contains q+barq and l+barl chiral supermultiplets plus singlet S; source explicitly parameterizes an otherwise unspecified Wbreaking. It is not a complete hidden-sector theory.

claims.locator: P21 Tables1.1/1.2 PDFpp9-10; P22 AppendixA Eqs.(A.1)-(A.2) PDFpp227-228
claims.fact: Three families Q,u^c,d^c,L,e^c; two Higgs chiral multiplets Hu,Hd with Y=+1/2,-1/2; adjoint gluino,wino,bino. P21 explicitly calls all chiral scalars complex and fermions LH Weyl. Both sources define gauge su3+su2+u1; RPV does not introduce additional matter. No auxiliary fields or repeated conjugate containers.

limitations: Full gauge-matter content, not the UV supersymmetry-breaking sector or all possible superpotential choices.
